item.title: MongoDB Server Security Update, December 2025
item.description:
📝 On December 12, 2025, the MongoDB Security Engineering team identified a security vulnerability, described in CVE-2025-14847, which impacts MongoDB Server. Tens of thousands of MongoDB Atlas customers and hundreds of thousands of Atlas instances were proactively patched within days. In parallel with our Atlas remediation, we published patch versions of MongoDB for customers running MongoDB Enterprise Advanced.
🔗 Read more: https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/news/mongodb-server-security-update-december-2025
